versions.content: Rationale for the modeling of the multiplicity of Diag- nosticAccessPermission . securityLevel The multiplicity of DiagnosticAc- cessPermission . securityLevel has been set to 0..* with the following motivation: • The DiagnosticSession where the attribute DiagnosticSession . id is set to 0x01 shall not be associated with a DiagnosticSecurityLevel . • There are no associated DiagnosticSecurityLevel s required. As a conse- quence, the execution of the DiagnosticServiceInstance that references the given DiagnosticAccessPermission is always possible.
